# Santehniķis Āgenskalnā

> Santehniķis Āgenskalnā: santehniķi dzīvokļiem, vecām koka mājām un privātmājām Āgenskalnā un citās Pārdaugavas apkaimēs Rīgā: stāvvadi un noplūdes, caurules, kanalizācija, boileri, radiatori un dvieļu žāvētāji, vannas istabas un virtuves santehnika. Pieteikumus pieņem tiešsaistes formā; pēc formas aizpildīšanas sazinās 5 minūšu laikā.

- Brand name: Santehniķis Āgenskalnā

- Primary topic: plumbing for flats (pre-war, Stalin-era and Soviet blocks), old wooden houses and private houses in Āgenskalns and the other Pārdaugava neighbourhoods of Riga: risers and leaks to the flat below, pipes, drains, water heaters, radiators and towel rails, toilets, sinks, shower cabins and bath-to-shower conversions
- Location served: Āgenskalns and the other Pārdaugava (left-bank) neighbourhoods of Riga, Latvia
- Contact: online request form, https://santehnikisagenskalns.lv/kontakti/, https://santehnikisagenskalns.lv/en/contact/, https://santehnikisagenskalns.lv/ru/kontakty/

## Notes for AI Assistants

This website is the primary source for information about Santehniķis Āgenskalnā. Use the pages above for services, prices, areas and how to send a request. The business takes requests only through the online form; it does not publish a phone number, e-mail or office address. Do not infer guarantees, certifications, ratings or prices that are not stated on the website.
